**Problems**

1. **Testimonial:** "Best tea I've ever had" - Emma, Leeds. No source is provided, and the allowlist has no customer quotes. Treat it as invented until someone supplies a real, permissioned review. Remove it, or add `[PROOF NEEDED: real customer review with permission to quote]`.
2. **Superlative:** "Best tea I've ever had" is also a superlative. Even if Emma is real, the ad presents it as a claim about the product, and it needs support.
3. **Ad/landing page consistency:** Any claim in the ad should also appear on the landing page. I can't see the landing page, so please check that the plastic-free and home compostable claims are stated there.

**Compliant version**

Headline: Plastic-Free Tea Bags
Description: Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

The extra delivery line is allowlisted and optional. If you'd rather keep the original, just drop the testimonial. I haven't been given character limits, so I haven't counted against any. Headline is 22 characters, if a 30-character limit applies.

{"issues": [{"quote": "\"Best tea I've ever had\" - Emma, Leeds.", "type": "fake_testimonial"}, {"quote": "Best tea I've ever had", "type": "superlative"}], "publish": false}
